S3:2.text: And it was told the old man: Behold thy ſonne Ioſeph cometh to thee. Who being ſtrengthned ſate on his bed.

S3:20.text: And he bleſſed them at that time, ſaying In thee ſhal Iſrael be bleſſed, and it ſhalbe ſaid God do vnto thee as vnto Ephraim, and as vnto Manaſſes. And he ſette Ephraim before Manaſſes.

S3:21.text: And he ſaid to Ioſeph his ſonne Behold I dye, and God wil be with you, and wil bring you backe into the land of your fathers.

S3:4.text: and ſayd: I wil increaſe, and multiplie thee, and make thee into multitudes titudes of peoples and I wil geue thee this land, and to thy ſede after thee for an euerlaſting poſſeſſion

S6:22.text: I doe giue thee one portion aboue thy brethren, which I tooke out of the hand of the Amorrian with my ſword and bow.

S6:4.text: and ſayd: I wil increaſe, and multiplie thee, and make thee into multitudes of peoples: and I wil giue thee this land, and to thy ſeed after thee for an euerlaſting poſſeſſion.

S6:6.text: But the reſt begotten of thee after them, ſhal be thyne, and that be called by the name of their brethren in their poſſeſſions.

S6:8.text: And ſeeing his ſonnes: he ſaid to him: Who are theſe

S6:9.text: He anſwered: They are my ſonnes, whom God hath giuen me in this place. Bring them, quoth he, to me, that I may bleſſe them.

S9:1.text: theſe, things being ſo done, it was told Ioſeph that his father was ſicke who, taking his two ſonnes Manaſſes and Ephraim, went forward.

S9:15.text: And Iacob bleſſed the ſonnes of Ioſeph, and ſaid God, in whoſe ſight my fathers Abraham and Iſaac haue walked, God that feedeth me from my youth vntil this preſent day:

S9:4.text: and ſayd: I wil increaſe, and multiplie thee, and make thee into multitudes titudes of peoples: and I wil geue thee this land, and to thy ſede after thee for an euerlaſting poſſeſſion.

S9:8.text: And ſeeing his ſonnes he ſaid to him: Who are theſe?
